question_en: How many Target stores are in Texas, and how much retail space do they have, as of February 1, 2025?
question_vi: Tính đến ngày 1/2/2025, Target có bao nhiêu cửa hàng ở Texas và tổng diện tích bán lẻ là bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: As of February 1, 2025, Target had 157 stores in Texas with 21,580 thousand retail square feet.

question_en: In the December 2022 8-K, what ownership level and group size does VICI Properties' new proxy access bylaw require for shareholders to nominate directors?
question_vi: Trong 8-K tháng 12/2022, điều lệ mới về proxy access của VICI Properties yêu cầu cổ đông phải sở hữu bao nhiêu và nhóm cổ đông tối đa bao nhiêu người để đề cử thành viên hội đồng quản trị?
reference_answer: VICI added Section 14 to Article II of its Amended and Restated Bylaws letting a stockholder, or a group of up to 20 stockholders, nominate directors up to the greater of two or 20% of the directors up for election, provided they own 3% or more of the common stock continuously for at least three years.
evidence_quotes: permit a stockholder, or a group of up to 20 stockholders, to nominate and include director candidates constituting up to the greater of two or 20% of the number of directors up for election at any annual meeting of stockholders
owns 3% or more of the Company’s outstanding common stock continuously for at least three years

question_en: How do Mosaic and Salesforce each describe weather or climate risk in the forward-looking statements of their November 2021 press releases?
question_vi: Trong phần tuyên bố hướng tới tương lai của thông cáo báo chí tháng 11/2021, Mosaic và Salesforce mỗi bên mô tả rủi ro về thời tiết hay khí hậu như thế nào?
reference_answer: Mosaic cites adverse weather conditions affecting operations in Central Florida, the Mississippi River basin, the Gulf Coast, Canada or Brazil, including hurricanes, excess heat, cold, snow, rainfall or drought. Salesforce more generally cites the impact of climate change, natural disasters and public health emergencies, including the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.
evidence_quotes: adverse weather conditions affecting operations in Central Florida, the Mississippi River basin, the Gulf Coast of the United States, Canada or Brazil, and including potential hurricanes, excess heat, cold, snow, rainfall or drought
the impact of climate change, natural disasters and actual or threatened public health emergencies, including the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic

question_en: What climate and emissions-regulation risks does CMS Energy warn about in its fiscal 2021 10-K?
question_vi: CMS Energy cảnh báo những rủi ro nào liên quan đến biến đổi khí hậu và quy định về khí thải trong báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2021?
reference_answer: In its fiscal 2021 10-K, CMS Energy says environmental laws could force it to add emission controls, buy carbon allowances, curtail operations or invest in lower-carbon generation, and flags litigation, reputational harm and extreme weather as further risks. Consumers expects to recover compliance costs from customers through rates but cannot guarantee it.
evidence_quotes: Federal and state environmental laws and rules, as well as international accords and treaties, could require CMS Energy and Consumers to install additional equipment for emission controls, undertake heat-rate improvement projects, purchase carbon emissions allowances, curtail operations
litigation originated by third parties against CMS Energy or Consumers due to CMS Energy’s or Consumers’ greenhouse gas or other emissions or CCR disposal and storage
impairment of CMS Energy’s or Consumers’ reputation due to their greenhouse gas or other emissions
extreme weather conditions, such as severe storms or flooding, that may affect customer demand, company operations, or assets
Consumers expects to collect fully from its customers, through the ratemaking process, expenditures incurred to comply with environmental regulations, but cannot guarantee this outcome.

question_en: Which of RF, RJF, BRO and MTB bring up the FDIC in their fiscal 2022 10-K management discussion? Answer yes or no for each.
question_vi: Trong phần ban lãnh đạo thảo luận và phân tích (MD&A) của báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2022, công ty nào trong RF, RJF, BRO và MTB có nhắc đến FDIC? Trả lời có hoặc không cho từng công ty.
reference_answer: Regions (RF) yes, listing FDIC insurance assessments among its expenses; Raymond James (RJF) yes, mentioning FDIC-insured deposit accounts in its Bank segment; M&T (MTB) yes, citing FDIC assessments among expense drivers; Brown & Brown (BRO) no, its passage does not mention the FDIC.
evidence_quotes: professional, legal and regulatory expenses, FDIC insurance assessments, and other operating expenses, as well as income taxes.
We also provide FDIC-insured deposit accounts, including to clients of our broker-dealer subsidiaries
outside data processing and software, FDIC assessments, and professional services expenses.

question_en: What debt did Union Pacific agree to sell in its February 2025 8-K, and in what amounts and maturities?
